evidence.notes: Local Apex dynamic SOQL executes =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE, and NOT LIKE predicates against local test data.

source.content: @isTest private class SoqlComparisonOpsTest { @isTest static void comparisonOperatorsRunLocally() { insert new List<Account>{ new Account(Name = 'Acme', AnnualRevenue = 100), new Account(Name = 'Alpine', AnnualRevenue = 175), new Account(Name = 'Beta', AnnualRevenue = 250), new Account(Name = 'Gamma', AnnualRevenue = 400) }; List<SObject> exactRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Acme\''); System.assertEquals(1, exactRows.size()); List<SObject> notEqualRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != \'Acme\''); System.assertEquals(3, notEqualRows.size()); List<SObject> lowerRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue < 200'); System.assertEquals(2, lowerRows.size()); List<SObject> lowerOrEqualRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue <= 175'); System.assertEquals(2, lowerOrEqualRows.size()); List<SObject> greaterRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue > 200'); System.assertEquals(2, greaterRows.size()); List<SObject> greaterOrEqualRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue >= 250'); System.assertEquals(2, greaterOrEqualRows.size()); List<SObject> inRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name IN (\'Acme\', \'Gamma\')'); System.assertEquals(2, inRows.size()); List<SObject> notInRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name NOT IN (\'Acme\', \'Gamma\')'); System.assertEquals(2, notInRows.size()); List<SObject> likeRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE \'A%\''); System.assertEquals(2, likeRows.size()); List<SObject> notLikeRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name NOT LIKE \'A%\''); System.assertEquals(2, notLikeRows.size()); } }
